description.value:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the crystal sphere or the sphere is removed from the pedestal

Effect The chamber seems to fade away and is replaced by an image of the Storval Plateau at night. Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:40] save or become convinced they've been transported to Golarion's surface. A creature can disbelieve the illusion by succeeding at a Perception check to [[/act seek dc=40]]. The hazard then rolls initiative.

details.description: An illusion of the Storval Plateau fills creatures with a longing for the surface.
details.disable: @Check[stealth|dc:36] (master) to approach the crystal sphere followed by @Check[thievery|dc:38] (master) to remove the sphere from the pedestal without triggering the hazard, or @Check[arcana|dc:36] or @Check[occultism|dc:36] (expert) twice to unweave the illusion, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dispel Magic] (8th rank; counteract DC 34)
details.reset: The hazard deactivates automatically after 1 minute. The hazard reactivates after 1 hour unless the crystal is removed from the pedestal.
details.routine:
(1 action) The hazard fills the hearts of those affected by the illusion with a longing for the surface. Each creature in the area that hasn't disbelieved the illusion attempts a @Check[will|dc:38|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied,inflicts:slowed] save. This is an emotion and mental effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.
